parts.t: Champlain Heights is a planned community in Southeast Vancouver, designed with families in mind. Surrounded by parks, ravines, and trails, it offers a suburban feel within city limits, with townhomes and family homes that provide excellent value compared to other Vancouver neighbourhoods.
